questions.question: Which SQL command is used to permanently remove a table structure along with its data?

options.D: TRUNCATE only for rows without removing table definition always

questions.explanation: DROP removes the table definition and data. DELETE removes rows; TRUNCATE clears rows but table remains.

questions.question: In a relational database, a candidate key that is not chosen as the primary key is called:
questions.explanation: Non-selected candidate keys are alternate keys.

questions.question: Which normal form removes partial dependency on a composite primary key?
questions.explanation: 2NF eliminates partial dependency; 3NF eliminates transitive dependency.

questions.question: Which JOIN returns only matching rows from both tables?
questions.explanation: INNER JOIN keeps intersecting/matching rows only.

questions.question: COMMIT in a database transaction is mainly related to which ACID property?
questions.explanation: After COMMIT, changes persist (durability). Atomicity is all-or-nothing.

questions.question: Which scheduling algorithm may cause starvation of longer processes?
questions.explanation: SJF can starve long jobs if short jobs keep arriving.

questions.question: Thrashing in an operating system refers to:

options.C: Excessive paging with little useful work

questions.explanation: Thrashing = too many page faults; system spends time swapping.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT typically a process state?
questions.explanation: Compiling is not a standard process state.

questions.question: In memory management, a page table is used to map:
questions.explanation: Page tables translate virtual page numbers to frame numbers.

questions.question: Which device works primarily using MAC addresses?
questions.explanation: Switches forward using MAC; routers use IP.

questions.question: Which protocol provides reliable end-to-end delivery at the transport layer?
questions.explanation: TCP is reliable and connection-oriented; UDP is not.

questions.question: Default port number for SSH is:
questions.explanation: SSH uses port 22; Telnet 23; FTP 21; SMTP 25.

questions.question: IPv6 address size is:
Which topology has a single central hub/switch connecting all nodes?
questions.explanation: Star uses a central connecting device.

questions.question: Which data structure is best for implementing recursion (function call management)?
questions.explanation: Call stack uses LIFO behavior of stacks.

questions.question: Time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements is:
questions.explanation: Binary search halves search space each step → O(log n).

questions.question: In SDLC, creating SRS (Software Requirements Specification) belongs mainly to:
questions.explanation: SRS is produced during requirements analysis.

questions.question: White-box testing primarily focuses on:
questions.explanation: White-box tests internal paths/logic; black-box tests I/O behavior.

questions.question: Which cloud model provides a ready development environment (runtime, middleware) without managing OS?
questions.explanation: PaaS = platform; IaaS = VMs/infra; SaaS = finished apps.

questions.question: A digital signature primarily ensures:

options.A: Authenticity and integrity of a message

Replace the underlined: He is enough tall to touch the shelf.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: Open banking brings benefits but needs strong security and regulated access
options.B: Open banking should remove all authentication

questions.context:
Directions (Q38–Q41): Read the passage.

Open banking allows third-party providers to access customer banking data through secure APIs, with customer consent. This can improve product comparison and faster lending decisions. However, it also increases the attack surface for cybercriminals. Banks must enforce strong authentication, encryption in transit, and continuous API monitoring. Customers should grant access only to regulated apps and revoke permissions they no longer use. Regulators emphasize that convenience must not weaken data protection standards.

questions.question: According to the passage, open banking access happens mainly through:
questions.explanation: Text states access via secure APIs with consent.

questions.question: What risk does the passage associate with open banking?
questions.explanation: It increases attack surface for cybercriminals.

Statements: P ≥ Q = R > S ≤ T. Conclusions: I. P > S  II. T ≥ R. Which follows?
questions.explanation: P ≥ Q = R > S ⇒ P > S (I). T ≥ R is not definite from S ≤ T.

questions.question: Statements: A < B ≤ C = D ≥ E. Conclusion: A < D. Does it follow?
questions.explanation: A < B ≤ C = D ⇒ A < D.

questions.question: Codes: % means ≥ , # means < , @ means = , $ means >. Statement: M % N $ O # P. Conclusion: M > O?
questions.explanation: M ≥ N > O < P ⇒ M > O follows.

questions.question: Statements: All servers are computers. Some computers are laptops. Conclusions: I. Some servers are laptops. II. All computers are servers.
questions.explanation: Some servers are laptops not definite; II reverse all doesn't follow.

questions.question: Statements: No API is database. All databases are systems. Conclusions: I. No API is system. II. Some systems are not APIs.
questions.explanation: I does not follow (API could still be system via other path). Systems that are databases are not APIs ⇒ some systems are not APIs (II).

questions.question: Statements: All routers are devices. All devices need power. Conclusion: All routers need power.

questions.question:
What is Geeta's rank from the top in a class of 40?
I. Geeta is 8 ranks below Seema who is 20th from the top.
II. Geeta's rank from the bottom is 13.

options.B: Either I or II alone sufficient

questions.explanation: I: Geeta=28th from top. II: from top=40-13+1=28. Either alone enough.

II. Diwali was on Wednesday.

questions.question: A is the brother of B. B is the daughter of C. D is the father of A. How is C related to D?
questions.explanation: D is father of A; C is parent of A's sister B ⇒ C is mother ⇒ wife of D.
